name: What should I look for when choosing a commercial restoration company?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a commercial restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a commercial restoration company, look for experience with commercial properties, 24/7 emergency availability, and a comprehensive range of services. Ensure they are licensed and insured, and inquire about their certifications, such as from the IICRC. Review customer testimonials and ask for references. A reliable company like First To Respond Restoration will also offer transparent communication and work directly with your insurance provider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company with commercial experience, 24/7 service, licensing, insurance, relevant certifications, and good customer reviews.
